english.note: Use this especially when clothes, colours, or a style suit someone's appearance or image.
Use 襯 when matching colours, clothes, or other visually coordinated items rather than pairing objects into sets.
Use this for clothes, colours, or accessories that look attractive on a particular person.

examples.english: This shirt really seems to suit you.
examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 can3 nei5 wo3

examples.english: This blue shirt and these white trousers match well.
examples.traditional: 呢件藍色恤衫同條白褲好襯。
